correctness.rationale: For a b=2 block each column takes uniformly ±e1 or ±e2. Multiplying by fixed orthogonal 2×2 Hadamard H2 sends the four states bijectively to (±1,±1)/√2, making all transformed matrix entries independent Rademacher/√(2ζ), block and column independence being preserved. Hence whole-matrix distribution and joint Gram laws match all deterministic-input dense-sign sketches. At b=1 identical law is immediate. For m≥2 and b≥3, one offdiagonal Gram entry has fourth-moment difference (b−1)(b−2)/(b³ζ³)>0, derived using centered independent block collision variables and 3Σpair second-moment products. This excludes Gram equality for all ζ. For m=1 Gram is identically one at all b and is properly excluded. Independent exhaustive finite Gram distribution checks in 5 small configurations and 126 exact rational parameter moment checks succeeded.

The sharp fourth-moment obstruction at widths ≥3 delineates precisely where the shortcut ceases; claims carefully avoid GPU speed, adaptivity and floating point.

limitations: m≥2, ζ≥1; real, fully independent signed hashes and exact arithmetic, deterministic/independent inputs only.
No claim of Gaussian equivalence, finite-precision robustness, or pointwise dominance of distribution tails.
